answer: Funding lineage carries weight. A deposit is traced back two hops, and deposits sharing an ancestor within the same hour collapse into one cluster, so fifty keys paid from one wallet stay one voice however many pulse beats they emit. A mixer payout scores zero unless the address is new, since reuse leaves the first pigment readable in the graph. Each cluster keeps a mirror of its funding tree, so a farmer needs fifty on-ramps: fifty KYC exchange accounts near $30 each, $4 withdrawal fees, about $1,700, plus a day per batch. A repainted hull still shows the older layer when scraped.
